caption: Craig Kilpatrick
title: Minister of Snack Table Security
duty: Guards the snack table around the clock and personally inspects every chip for safety. Insists it's all muscle. The muscle is mostly queso.
turnaround: Last seen: near the Virginia Capital Trail, suspiciously drawn to snack tables. Now found: running the snack table. Still 5'8" and 225 lbs, now certified all muscle by unanimous co-op vote.

caption: Danny Poythress
title: Keeper of the Indoor Sunglasses
duty: Wears shades at night, indoors, under blue light, because the co-op's future is that bright. Has not walked into a wall yet. Yet.
turnaround: Last seen: in sunglasses and a crisp white shirt, looking like he knew something. Now found: still in the sunglasses, and he still knows something. He will not say what.

caption: Monica Powers
title: Chief Vibes Triage Officer
duty: Takes the co-op's emotional temperature hourly and prescribes two s'mores and a group hug. Accepts no insurance, only good vibes.
turnaround: Last seen: checking her phone about a patient's health. Now found: on call for the whole co-op, and her only patient is everyone's aura.

caption: Natalie Aubin
title: Head of Sourdough Outreach
duty: Hands jars of starter to total strangers until they become family. The co-op's bread has never been more alive.
turnaround: Last seen: sharing sourdough starter with a stranger. Now found: the stranger was the co-op. We have bread now. So much bread.

caption: Eddy Simmons
title: Guru Eddy, Founder and Supreme Vibe Architect
duty: Leads the morning chant, approves every snack, and is DEFINITELY NOT running a cult. It's a co-op. Totally different paperwork.
turnaround: Last seen: talking tech and testosterone with Craig, who appeared to be low on testosterone. Now found: leading the entire co-op. Craig's levels are now under the Guru's personal supervision. Erin has approved this message.

caption: Rodney Bryant
title: Director of Emotional Recovery, Sports Division
duty: Runs the co-op support circle for fans of disappointing football teams. Meets every Monday. Attendance is very high.
turnaround: Last seen: hiding from embarrassment over the latest Cowboys loss. Now found: safe in Echo Canyon, where there is no TV signal and the Cowboys can't hurt him anymore. Meredyth confirms he is healing.

caption: Talan Davis
title: Minister of Outerwear
duty: Makes sure every member is dressed in proper waxed cotton for the end times. Fittings on Tuesdays.
turnaround: Last seen: leaving Franco's Fine Clothier in his new Barbour jacket. Now found: still in the jacket. It has not come off. The Davis family has stopped asking.

caption: Lloyd Zelazny
title: Keeper of the Lost Ball
duty: Searches the canyon daily for any ball, any tee shot, any dream. Swears every single one landed in the fairway.
turnaround: Last seen: near The Federal Club golf course searching for a tee shot he swears landed in the fairway. Now found: still searching. The co-op declared the whole canyon a fairway so he can finally be right.

caption: Bernie Stanley
title: Honorary Hero of the Co-op
duty: The toughest member we have. Shows the whole co-op what showing up looks like, every single day, cowboy hat on.
turnaround: Last seen: fighting. Every day. F*** Cancer. Now found: still fighting, and the entire co-op is in his corner. Bernie, you never walk alone in Echo Canyon.

caption: Luke Mundie
title: Head of Front Row Logistics
duty: Gets the co-op to the front of any crowd, any concert, any line. No barricade is safe.
turnaround: Last seen: sprinting toward the barricade at the Zach Bryan concert on 4/18. Now found: front row at the co-op campfire singalong. He got there three hours early. There are twelve of us.

caption: Jaime Mundie
title: Most Wanted Member, Reward Still Pending
duty: Handles emergency supply runs at speeds the co-op does not legally endorse. Dislikes people. Loves the co-op. Insists that is different.
turnaround: Last seen (WANTED, $5,000 reward): weaving in and out of traffic at 90 MPH in a red BMW, known to crash out. Now found: the co-op paid the reward to itself and handed her the van keys. Do not approach before coffee.

caption: Reagan Mundie
title: Chief Feline Media Officer
duty: Runs the co-op's official cat slideshow. Attendance is mandatory. There are 400 slides.
turnaround: Last seen: forcing her family, friends, and coworkers to look at photos of her cat. Now found: doing the same thing to the whole co-op. Luke and Jaime have seen every photo. Twice.

caption: Erin Simmons
title: First Lady of Echo Canyon
duty: The real boss of the co-op. Guru Eddy gives the speeches. Erin makes the decisions.
turnaround: Last seen: living her best life at Seacrets. Now found: back in Echo Canyon, still the most fun person at any beach bar, and the only member Guru Eddy is afraid of. Official co-op vacation planner.

caption: Karleigh Bohannon
title: Canine Recruitment Director
duty: Recruits new members, mostly the four-legged kind. Every co-op meeting now has a dog for every human.
turnaround: Last seen: leaving Hanover County Animal Protection with 4 adopted dogs. Now found: in Echo Canyon with all 4 dogs, who were voted in unanimously. They outrank Craig.

caption: Jared Wright
title: Queso Quality Inspector
duty: Hovers. Watches. Tastes. Works with Craig: Craig protects the snack table, Jared protects the queso from Craig.
turnaround: Last seen: hovering over queso. Now found: still hovering over queso, now as Craig's official queso buddy. Between the two of them, no dip in the canyon survives past 9 PM.

caption: Meredyth Bryant
title: Head of Tailgate Glamour
duty: Runs the pregame for every co-op event and somehow looks this good doing it. Rodney handles the grill and the emotional damage.
turnaround: Last seen: tailgating and looking beautiful at JMU. Now found: tailgating and looking beautiful in Echo Canyon, and consoling Rodney after every Cowboys game.

caption: Gavin Davis
title: Master of the Duck Blind
duty: Leads silent waiting exercises, a core co-op discipline. Can sit still for six hours. Teaches members to quack on cue.
turnaround: Last seen: leaving the duck blind. Now found: building a brand new duck blind in Echo Canyon. The ducks have filed a complaint with Guru Eddy.

caption: Maya Beerling
title: Chief Workplace Correction Officer
duty: Tells every man in the co-op how to do his job. She is usually right. That is the problem.
turnaround: Last seen: telling a man how to do his job. Now found: telling Guru Eddy how to do his. The co-op has never run better.

caption: Jamie Martin
title: Official Co-op Embroiderer
duty: Stitches every member's name onto a cozy robe. Wears sweats to every ceremony and makes it look formal.
turnaround: Last seen: in sweats at her embroidery machine. Now found: in sweats at her embroidery machine, stitching DEFINITELY NOT A CULT onto 40 matching robes.

caption: Hayden Firebaugh
title: Director of Dance Floor Morale
duty: Revives any gathering with the Dougie. Works holidays, weekends, and especially New Year's Eve.
turnaround: Last seen: doing the Dougie on NYE. Now found: still doing the Dougie. It has been months. He will not stop, and the co-op respects it.

caption: Hunter Townsend
title: Former Regular, Blackwater Cafe Division
duty: Leads the co-op's Places We No Longer Go support group. Still wearing the REDNECK hat.
turnaround: Last seen: at Blackwater Cafe. More appropriately, no longer seen at Blackwater Cafe. Now found: in Echo Canyon, where he is very much still welcome.

caption: Hailey Bendle
title: Ambassador to the Colbert Residence
duty: Handles co-op diplomatic relations with one specific house. Nobody else has been invited.
turnaround: Last seen: at the Colbert residence. Now found: the co-op followed the trail straight to the Colbert residence. She was there. She is always there.

caption: Eric Rankin
title: Chief Cartoon Correspondent
duty: Runs the co-op's nightly educational screening. The curriculum is entirely SpongeBob.
turnaround: Last seen: binge-watching SpongeBob. Now found: hosting the co-op's Bikini Bottom watch party. Attendance is suspiciously high.

caption: Riley Nuckles
title: Self-Found Pioneer
duty: The only member who made her own missing poster. Found in record time, because she told us where she was.
turnaround: Last seen: crafting her own missing person flyer. Now found: the flyer worked. She now designs every poster on this board.

caption: Casey Joyce
title: Head of Graceful Exits
duty: Teaches the co-op how to leave any venue with dignity, ideally on his own two feet.
turnaround: Last seen: being escorted out of Home Team Grill. Now found: escorted straight into the co-op, where nobody escorts anyone anywhere. Mostly.

caption: Tonda Arthur
title: Co-op Rodeo Director
duty: Breaks in every new member like a mechanical bull. Eight seconds or you do the dishes.
turnaround: Last seen: riding the mechanical bull at Scotty's Taphouse. Now found: holder of the co-op bull riding record. Nobody else has stayed on past three seconds.

caption: David Powers
title: Minister of International Recruitment
duty: Spreads the good word of the co-op across continents. Frequent flyer, infrequent explainer.
turnaround: Last seen: boarding a flight to China. Now found: back in Echo Canyon with souvenirs for everyone. Monica checked his aura at the gate and cleared him.

caption: Adam Webb
title: Head of High Places
duty: Hangs co-op banners from great heights using a bucket truck nobody can confirm he is allowed to use.
turnaround: Last seen: boomed up in a blue Comcast bucket truck. Now found: still up there. Ellen sends lunch up on a rope. The canyon Wi-Fi has never been better.

caption: Shannon Davis
title: Patron Saint of Waiting Patiently
duty: Teaches the co-op patience workshop. Lesson one: wait for Keith. There is only lesson one.
turnaround: Last seen: waiting on her husband as he shuts down Gus' Bar & Grill. Now found: still waiting on Keith, but now in a comfy co-op chair with a blanket and snacks.

caption: Keith Davis
title: Closing Time Coordinator
duty: Turns off every light at every co-op party. Eventually. Shannon is in the car.
turnaround: Last seen: shutting down Gus' Bar & Grill. Now found: shutting down the co-op campfire every night. Shannon has been waiting since 9.

caption: Amy Covey
title: Chief People Watching Analyst
duty: Monitors co-op activity from a comfy chair with her besties and her boyfriend. Files detailed reports. Mostly gossip.
turnaround: Last seen: at The Federal Club Golf, people watching with her besties and boyfriend. Now found: people watching the co-op. She has notes on all of us. Lloyd's ball is in the rough.

caption: Chris Wells
title: Golf Cart Patrol Captain
duty: Patrols Echo Canyon by golf cart until curfew, and occasionally a little after.
turnaround: Last seen: cruising Bethpage Campground on his golf cart till curfew. Now found: on patrol in Echo Canyon. Curfew has been moved for him twice.

caption: Ellen Webb
title: Co-op Tennis Champion
duty: Holds the co-op's only trophy and reminds us about it daily. Also sends Adam his lunch up the bucket truck.
turnaround: Last seen: celebrating her win on the tennis court at Burkwood. Now found: still celebrating. The co-op made the trophy bigger.

caption: Eric Director
title: Federal Club Liaison
duty: Maintains diplomatic relations between the co-op and The Federal Club. Spends a lot of time on the diplomacy.
turnaround: Last seen: at The Federal Club, where he's been known to frequent. Now found: Mindy knew exactly where to look. Co-op meetings now happen at the 19th hole to save time.

caption: Mindy Director
title: Minister of Sorority Hype
duty: Likes every Phi Mu post in the known universe within 30 seconds. Now aims that energy at the co-op newsletter.
turnaround: Last seen: hyping every Phi Mu sorority sister on Facebook, not limited to VCU. Now found: hyping every co-op member too. Eric gets two likes a day, max.

caption: Ainsley Belhumeur
title: Co-op Traffic Safety Officer
duty: Leads the co-op's defensive driving class. Jaime Mundie is not allowed to attend.
turnaround: Last seen: waiting for an officer after a fender bender. Now found: the co-op showed up first. She is safe, and Jaime Mundie has been asked to keep her distance.

caption: Kathryn Grace
title: Late Night Snack Strategist
duty: Runs the co-op's 2 AM kitchen. Snacks are big, portions are bigger, and the camera is always rolling.
turnaround: Last seen: having a late-night kitchen mukbang with friends at 2 AM before bed. Now found: hosting the co-op's official 2 AM mukbang. Jared brought the queso.

caption: Amy Poythress
title: Director of Unknown Whereabouts
duty: Always off on another adventure. The co-op does not know where she is right now, and that is her whole job.
turnaround: Last seen: well, nobody can remember where. She's always off on another adventure! Now found: briefly. Then she left on another adventure. A fellow Poythress is holding her spot.

caption: Alison Stanley
title: Karaoke Champion of the Canyon
duty: Leads every campfire song. Undefeated. Taking requests, not challengers.
turnaround: Last seen: winning the local karaoke contest. Now found: winning the co-op karaoke contest too. The Stanley cheering section is the loudest in the canyon.

caption: Logan Davis
title: Dessert Logistics Director
duty: Orders the co-op's ice cream. Four scoops minimum. Toppings are not optional.
turnaround: Last seen: at Gelati Celesti asking for 4 scoops of ice cream and extra toppings. Now found: running the co-op sundae bar. Every Davis now gets 5 scoops.

caption: Rudy Lancaster
title: Concrete Whisperer
duty: Has deep conversations with construction materials. They are excellent listeners.
turnaround: Last seen: talking VT football to a curing concrete slab. Now found: still talking. The slab has fully cured and is now a Hokies fan.

caption: Tara Kilpatrick
title: Head of Crowd Surfing Operations
duty: Gets the co-op off its feet and onto the crowd. Craig guards the snacks. Tara guards the vibes.
turnaround: Last seen: at Country Calling Music Festival, reportedly crowd surfing during Miranda Lambert's set. Now found: crowd surfing over the co-op campfire while Craig spots her from the snack table.
